claim: .RADIX 16 is set once in the shared include MLDEF and inherited via .INCLUDE by every CPU module, so a bare literal is hex.
The shared coin module COIN65 (assembled separately) sets its own .RADIX 16, space-indented in this file.
COIN65 restores the caller radix on exit (.RADIX .RAD), the same save/restore Centipede documents.
NDDT =4 carries no trailing period, so it is hex four — the DDT-bomb count, a bare-hex equate.
